name: Kurose Hinako
source:
Main heroine. She met a young [url=https://vndb.org/c95610]Kiichi[/url] and helped him overcome his fears and face his bullies. Despite the two being close, Kiichi suddenly stopped showing up to their usual hang out spot and eventually they grew apart.

She gets knocked up by her boyfriend [url=https://vndb.org/c95611]Jouji[/url] while still in high school and is disowned by her parents. Marrying Jouji, she gives birth to their daughter [url=https://vndb.org/c95612]Hina[/url] and at the start of the story the three of them are living together as a family.
